svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 06 · Merced · 04/12 Almond Bloom (Uncommon)
svg.desc: Late winter the orchards go white all at once. Petals blow across the road like a slow snow. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
